verdict.rationale: Gusto's Embedded Payroll API supports the constituent pieces of employee onboarding (creating W-2 employee records with personal details/pay rates, configuring federal/state tax withholding, benefits deductions, multi-location handling), and an official MCP server (dev-assistant-mcp) lets AI coding agents interact with the API/docs, which is agent-friendly infrastructure. However, the evidence never shows a single documented end-to-end 'create employee + compensation + tax setup' workflow orchestrated by an agent, nor an explicit agent-callable onboarding flow beyond human-facing pre-built UI Flows. Missing for 10: a documented single API/agent workflow chaining employee creation, compensation setup, and tax onboarding into one attested end-to-end sequence, and evidence of an agent actually performing this via API/MCP rather than just having access to docs.
